description: This file contains unit tests for the AclModified class within the Eclipse Ditto project, specifically testing immutability, equality, JSON serialization/deserialization, and exception handling in various scenarios.

classes.name: AclModifiedTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing AclModified JSON serialization, immutability, equality, and exception scenarios.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that the AclModified class and related classes are immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the equals and hashCode methods of AclModified using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThingIdString
methods.description: Tests that creating an AclModified instance with null String ThingId throws ThingIdInvalidException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThingId
methods.description: Tests that creating an AclModified instance with null ThingId throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullAcl
methods.description: Tests that creating an AclModified instance with null AccessControlList throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies the toJson method returns expected JSON structure for a valid AclModified instance.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJson
methods.description: Tests creating an AclModified instance from JSON string and verifies correctness of deserialization.
